spark_open.description: The creature is a large hybrid standing upright on two hind legs in profile facing right, with the overall body, head, fur, legs and tail of a tawny lioness and a pair of very large outstretched bird wings attached at the shoulders and back. Its fur is short and tawny-brown with a lighter cream underbelly and muzzle, and its wings are broad and fully spread to either side, covered in dense layered feathers in shades of brown, tan, cream and gray. The animal is posed with its hind legs bent and its wings held open, showing detailed musculature and feather texture against a plain light background.
